entries.reason: H=A^2-B^2 is supported at zero. If H is nonzero, full spectral support of the point mass forces T+T to cover the whole cycle, so t(t+1)/2>=n. If H is zero, prime-order uncertainty applied to A-B and A+B gives a stronger approximately n/2 bound.
entries.reopen_condition: Use a nonlinear implicit-spectrum circuit, modular composition, recurrence compression, p-adic or theta evaluation, or another representation whose charged size is not expanded union support.
entries.scope: A quotient A(k)/B(k) of two exact additive-character sums, with B(k) nonzero and quotient equal to J_G(k) for every nonzero secp256k1 scalar. Cost is the number of distinct expanded frequencies in S_A union S_B; the value at zero is free.

global_warning: This is a representation-specific support lower bound. It is not an unrestricted arithmetic-circuit or ECDLP lower bound.
